items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no, not Ellis. I'll tell you a little later.

ctx.x: Yeah. But it might not have been just that time. But, anyway, --
Yeah, he had quite a good band. He had a guy playing -- so Wild Bill started playing guitar or something because he had a good guy on piano. Hardwick -- Cedric. Sedgewick. (Cedric Haywood -- ed)
